problems: Program began 2006 as AOA (osteopathic) residency; ACGME initial accreditation 2017. AOA-era OGME labels, completion after OGME-6 (McNeal, Marvin, Logan, Sawvel, Synkowski graduated at OGME/PGY6); 7 years for the 2015+ entrants (Benko, Klein PGY7). Rogers/Busch completion year (6 vs 7 years) unknown. Four consecutive unobserved years 2017-18..2020-21 (only 2-name partial in 2017-18) so the 2017-2020 entrant classes and Walker are unconfirmed for those years; 2024-25 unobserved. 2023-24 page incomplete. Graduates page has no years and is not updated past Cuoco (Guilliams, Adhikari missing). Busch NPI match earlier flagged 'switched specialty' is overridden by graduates list. Phase 2: the adjudicator still labels Hatcher 'switched specialty' from an NPI namesake; training_history row says departure_type unknown.
